name: Cua um
summary: Cua um chua ngọt is a sour-sweet crab braise Dân Việt names on the town menu. The same page prices cua hai da by the kilogram. It does not say the braise is that crab, and it does not print the method. Cua cúm, the mangrove crab in a 2014 story, is a different animal.
howToEat: Order it at lunch or dinner. A method was not printed.
Cua hai da is printed at 750,000 VND a kilogram on 2 Oct 2022, including the cooking. That figure is the live crab, not a printed price for the braise. A 2026 price is Check on arrival.
where: Đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất, xã Cần Giờ. The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Cua um — sour-sweet crab in Can Gio
seoDescription: Cua um chua ngọt is a sour-sweet crab braise Dân Việt names in Can Gio. The method was not printed. Cua hai da is priced separately. Check on arrival.
